name: github-connection
about: Settings, Connections, GitHub: the sign-in Cua uses when an agent asks to push and open a pull request. One row per host with its state in plain words (nothing found says to run gh auth login or paste a token; signed in with gh names the account; a saved token or one in the daemon's environment; a host switched off), a quiet mark only for a state that needs a look (a chosen account that is gone, a token that can do more than push and pull requests need), and behind a row the switch, the account picker (only with several gh accounts, with a way back to gh's own), how Cua signs in in order, what to run when nothing is signed in, Rescan and Paste a token. The data is the daemon's github.status; no token is ever in it. All data here is made up.
